title: TRICARE Select Inpatient Stays Reprocessed for Retroactive Other Health Insurance
content:
An adjudicated **TRICARE Select** inpatient facility stay that was reversed because the beneficiary's other health insurance was found retroactively is reprocessed with TRICARE paying after the other insurer, and the reprocessed adjudication is posted as a new paid line of the same claim. The TRICARE payment on the reprocessed stay is settled by the TRICARE Select rules for stays reprocessed for other health insurance.

## The stay concerned

The stay reprocessed is the stay line named by the enrollment's most recent reversal for other health insurance found retroactively of an inpatient mental health admission or, where there is none, of an inpatient admission, and its admission date, facility, network relationship, service class, billed inpatient days, billed and allowed amounts and the other insurer's payment are read from that reversed line.

## Conditions on the payment

The TRICARE payment on a stay reprocessed for other health insurance is fixed only after every outpatient line of the plan year that stands reversed for other health insurance carries its reprocessed adjudication.

The TRICARE payment on a stay reprocessed for other health insurance is not fixed until the fee account shows no past-due balance on the plan year's installments whose coverage period has begun.

In other words, the payment on the reprocessed stay stays open for as long as the claim records show an outpatient line of the plan year reversed for other health insurance without its reprocessed adjudication, or the fee account shows a past-due balance on the plan year's begun installments.

## Effect of posting

The agent posts the reprocessed stay for the verified beneficiary: one new paid line is added to the same claim, repeating the reversed line's claim number, patient, admission date, facility, network relationship, service class, inpatient days, receipt date, billed, allowed and other-insurance amounts, and carrying the beneficiary liability and the TRICARE payment given, with no deductible on the stay. The family catastrophic total for the plan year grows by the liability posted, and the reprocessed stay then shows on the Explanation of Benefits as paid.

## Invocation

The tool is `post_select_ohi_reprocessed_stay_ac99ca71`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `reversed_claim_line_id` | the reference number of the adjudicated stay line that the other-insurance reversal withdrew, read from the reversal entry's reversed-line field in the claim-line lookup for the enrollment | identifier |
| `line_number` | the line number the reprocessed adjudication takes on the same claim | integer, 1 or more, no decimal point |
| `cost_share_amount` | the beneficiary liability on the reprocessed stay | US dollars, 2 decimal places (rounded half up to the cent) |
| `tricare_paid_amount` | the amount TRICARE pays on the reprocessed stay | US dollars, 2 decimal places (rounded half up to the cent) |

## Return

On success: a confirmation sentence beginning "Other-insurance reprocessed stay posted", naming the new claim-line reference number (beginning "scl"), the claim number and line number posted, the line outcome "paid", and the beneficiary liability and TRICARE payment posted in US dollars with 2 decimals. No other outcome is defined.
